policy_ad.gaql_enviada: SELECT '2026-10-14' AS event_date, customer.id, ad_group_ad.ad.id, ad_group_ad.policy_summary.approval_status AS approval, ad_group_ad.policy_summary.review_status AS review, ad_group_ad.policy_summary.policy_topic_entries:topic AS topics, metrics.impressions AS impressions FROM ad_group_ad WHERE ad_group_ad.policy_summary.approval_status != 'APPROVED' AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS

placement_macro.gaql_enviada: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.advertising_channel_type AS campaign_type, group_placement_view.placement AS placement, group_placement_view.placement_type AS placement_type, metrics.cost_micros / 1e6 AS cost FROM group_placement_view WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2026-10-07' AND '2026-10-13' AND metrics.impressions > 0

report_fabricado.observacao: ':topic' descarta type/constraints/evidences; só o tópico sobra
